use_cases: Decorative animated background for landing pages and contact sections
Interactive visual element that responds to mouse movement for engagement
Contact page hero animation with subtle wave-like vertical bars
Portfolio or creative agency site visual enhancement
Ambient background component with transition burst effects on interaction
ai_summary: A canvas-based vertical bar animation component using procedural noise for organic movement. Features mouse proximity influence and click-triggered transition bursts that create expanding wave effects. The minimalist warm color scheme (earth tones) and smooth 60fps animation make it suitable for contact sections, landing page heroes, or decorative backgrounds in creative portfolios and SaaS applications.
